column1: # Known-gap ledger of hermit-cli/tests/deadline_slice_cap.rs on KVM. ci/kvm-gap-ledger.rs reads it
# for the validation node privileged-test.deadline_slice_cap_kvm, which runs the suite on
# --backend=kvm and names this file in its environment (HERMIT_KNOWN_GAP_LEDGER). The format is
# documented in ci/manifest-plan/src/known_gaps.rs; the receipt qualifier and the scorecard read it.
# Every test of the suite that is NOT listed here must pass on KVM, so a new test is required on
# KVM by default. A listed test is a known gap, and its row's outcome says what the node does:
# - failed or cpu_timeout: the node runs it, and it must fail exactly as its row says: an ordinary
#   failure whose output contains the signature, or a stop by the per-test CPU budget. That
#   failure is a non-blocking diagnostic failure (KNOWN-KVM-GAP), never a pass. A listed test that
#   passes, or fails some other way, fails the node.
# - skipped: the node does not run it. It prints KVM-GAP-SKIPPED for the row and leaves the test
#   out of its run by name, so nothing shows whether the gap is still there.
# When a gap is fixed, delete its row (the node then runs the test as a required one; required
# counts are derived from the suite less its rows, and the population is census-guarded), and run
# ./ci/sync-cell-config.sh to refresh the scorecard.
# A signature is text the failure's output must show; in it \n is a newline, \\ a backslash and
# <N> any run of digits. A cpu_timeout or skipped row has none: -.
# The ledger can only shrink; `make lint-checks` (lint-check-known-gap-ledgers) holds it to its
# history. "baseline" marks a row present, unchanged, since the ledger was introduced, with the
# coordinator's approval of 2026-10-30. A row added later, or one whose outcome or signature
# changes (turning a row skipped included), carries the full URL of a specific approving comment,
# review or commit in its approval field, and its commit message binds that URL to the row with a
# line
#     KVM-Gap-Approval: <URL> <id>
# A required test that leaves the suite or is #[ignore]d needs the same with KVM-Required-Removal.
# The check reads first parents only: put approval lines on commits that land by rebase, not on a
# merged side branch. Run `make lint-check-known-gap-ledgers` before landing any change to this
# file or to the suite (validation runs it in check.lint_checks): a version the check cannot read
# blocks it until the checker itself changes.
# Gaps: D and E+F' = the gaps of that letter in
# https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4929, whose slice 2 fixed E and G and promoted
# their rows. D fails as the named refusal the KVM backend gives for it: a thread with a
# descriptor table of its own. C (a KVM rt_sigsuspend that waits) and F' (a KVM masked ppoll
# that waits) left with SIGSHARE S2b, which KVM now requires. The T2 rows of
# https://github.com/rrnewton/hermit/issues/4954 left with KVM's preemption timer.
# SKIPPED ON KVM SINCE 2026-11-01: the rows below (six then; S2b promoted C and F', and slice 2
# of 4929 promoted E and G since), by the owner's directive of 2026-11-01,
# 7:20 PM EST: "Just disable known-failing tests, but make sure a high-priority task is filed to
# fix them." Until then the node ran them as diagnostics. They still run on ptrace, the suite's
# other backend, where they pass. The fix is tracked at priority 1 in minibeads dh-j7ocf,
# https://github.com/rrnewton/dev-hermit-beads/blob/main/issues/dh-j7ocf.md, which lists the six
# with their causes and the fix plan; each row's issue field is the GitHub issue of its own gap.
# Each row's approval is the coordinator's commit that filed dh-j7ocf under that directive.
id

# D: KVM refuses a thread clone without CLONE_FS|CLONE_FILES, a named refusal. Skipped on KVM; the fix is tracked in minibeads dh-j7ocf, https://github.com/rrnewton/dev-hermit-beads/blob/main/issues/dh-j7ocf.md
hermit-run::deadline_slice_cap$itimer_a_private_descriptor_table_consumer_re_arms

hermit-run::deadline_slice_cap$itimer_generation_discard_follows_the_wait_mask
